title: Generative UI V1 (3a of 4): a validated scene for every turn, behind a switch
requested_outcome: Owner-approved Generative UI V1 (docs/product-memory/GENERATIVE_UI_V1.md), objective 3a of 4: produce a validated scene for every turn on the server, behind a switch that is off by default, without changing anything the phone shows today. Objectives 1 and 2a gave app/scenes: evidence, descriptors for the read tools, the scene-plan schema, validate_scene with its decision trace, and payload.py. Build: (1) app/scenes/planner.py - plan_scene(question, answer, calls, context) returning a scene plan by deterministic rules, no model call: the turn's answer as the Answer; evidence built from the turn's tool results through the registered descriptors; a Collection only when the question asks to see a list; Findings only where the tool results or the existing derived-attention signals carry an attention reason; everything else reachable through the drill-down. The model-proposed planner in GENERATIVE_UI_V1.md comes later; shape the function so it can be swapped in. (2) In app/routes/turn.py, right after `ui = present(...)`, when the setting CLIVE_SCENES is on, plan, validate and build the payload, and add it to the turn's response as a separate `scene` field with the decision trace; the `ui` cards, the spoken answer and every other field stay exactly as they are; any exception in this path is logged and leaves `scene` absent; with the setting off the response is byte-for-byte unchanged. Read the setting the way the app already reads its settings. (3) Tests: tests/test_scene_planner.py covering a synthetic reproduction of the 2026-09-24 'any customers who need a reply' turn (tool results across orders, threads and customers where nobody is waiting) giving one Answer plus drill-down with no pii; a question asking for a list keeping a bounded Collection; and determinism; and tests/test_turn_scene.py proving the response is unchanged with the setting off, carries a valid scene with it on, and survives a planner exception. You cannot run commands: the loop runs the listed checks after you report and returns any failure output, and the independent review returns its findings, to your next attempt. Do not report an owner decision for GitHub acceptance: it runs automatically after your candidate is published.
acceptance_criteria: plan_scene is deterministic, uses only the turn's evidence and the registered descriptors, and can be swapped for a model planner
with CLIVE_SCENES off the turn response is byte-for-byte unchanged; with it on a validated scene and its trace are added as a separate field
the 2026-09-24 case gives one Answer plus drill-down with no pii
a planner exception never breaks a turn
every listed check passes in the worker's workspace
